comments.text: Huge congratulations to our dear S.E.A 2025 students who are paving the way towards a brighter future for Trinidad and Tobago by their diligence and high level of performance/excellence in schooling and learning. Networking all stakeholders can only bring great achievement to our wonderful children. May God continue to bless the parents, children and teachers of our nation so they can all experience success and good progress in their lives. A specially planned module on the topic/subject, "Morality" at every level in our schools can only help the education system  and our country to be more guided towards a safer community and a continuing reduction in crime.
comments.author: @RohiniRamb
